newsitem.title: USA: Group owning Talley wants CEO ousted.
newsitem.headline: Group owning Talley wants CEO ousted.

text.p: A group controlling 10.1 percent of the shares of Talley Industries said they are seeking to oust chief executive officer William Mallender and other members of the board of directors up for re-election at the annal meeting May 8 in Hartsvile, S.C.
The group, called SCREAM (Shareholders Committee to Remove Entrenched and Arrogant Management), said it has sent proxy materials to stockholders asking them to elect its two nominees to the board.

The group said it is also asking them to eliminate staggered terms for directors, allow anyone with 10 percent or more of voting stock to call a special stockholders' meeting and approve the removal of anti-takeover provisions in the company's bylaws.
The group said Talley's stock prices during the last decade have declined more than 53 percent, while the S&P 500 index climbed more than 200 percent over the same period.
